investigation_notes: Network security investigation of a monitored LAN. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over Zeek and Suricata logs (IDS alerts, Kerberos, HTTP downloads, TLS certificates, domains and external-destination activity). No root cause, impact or C2 attribution is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Network context: LAN segment range: 10.12.3.0/24 (10.12.3.0 through 10.12.3.255); Domain: fargreentech.com; Domain Controller: 10.12.3.3 - FARGREENTECH-DC; LAN segment gateway: 10.12.3.1; LAN segment broadcast address: 10.12.3.255.
